description: The bar chart illustrates the distribution of different fine-tuning design spaces across various parameters. The horizontal axis represents the design spaces, labeled as Uniform, Decreasing, Spindle, and Bottleneck. The vertical axis, which is the value axis, is not explicitly labeled with units or a scale, but it shows the frequency or count of each design space. The Uniform design space has the highest count, followed by Decreasing, Spindle, and Bottleneck, in descending order. The bars are uniformly colored and there is no indication of sorting or emphasis on any particular bar. The chart does not provide specific numerical values or a legend to indicate what the counts represent.
